generations.name: First generation (AMG.EA)
generations.notes: Electric AMG GT 4-Door on the AMG.EA platform, axial-flux motors, 800 V, about 106 kWh pack, up to 600 kW DC peak. EPA rates GT 55 and GT 63 for MY2027 (GT 53 announced later). Confidence: medium (pre-launch figures) (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/796361/2027-mercedes-amg-gt-4-door-coupe/
